The *biolutoxR* package is composed of four main functions:

example.biolutoxR()

> Serves to process data analysis with your own data

run.biolutoxR()

> Serves to process data analysis with pre-entered data

import.biolutoxR()

> Serves to import a .xlsx file (in correct format) in the application

citation.biolutoxR()

> Serves to cite the package
